description: Framework wrapper config for Dart/Flutter projects — used by Run-Tests.ps1. Dart-native test config (tags, platforms) stays in dart_test.yaml at project root once the Flutter scaffold exists.

testing._comment_discoveryCommand: flutter test has no collect-only/dry-run mode, so discovery is a filesystem scan for the *_test.dart naming convention (paths relative to {testDir}).
testing._comment_stopOnFirstFailure: package:test flag forwarded by flutter test; verify against the installed Flutter SDK when the app scaffold lands (0.x foundation work).

data.name: data
data.purpose: Models, repositories, and data-source access (e.g. Supabase clients)

services.name: services
services.purpose: Business logic and state management services

directoryStructure.sublayerThresholdDescription: Add sublayers within a feature directory when it exceeds this many files

doc_extraction._comment: Doc-comment extraction spec for the Source Code Documentation Map (Build-DocumentationMap.ps1 -Tree SC, PF-IMP-1955). Declaring this block is all a language needs to join the SC map — the generic engine (Get-MarkerDocDescription in DescriptionExtraction.psm1) is driven by these markers; no framework-script edit required. The doc block must precede the first code line and only its first paragraph is indexed.
